changelog:
🚀 Initial release v1.0.0

All-in-one morning briefing that combines:
- Google Calendar events with conflict detection
- Gmail/Outlook email highlights (prioritized, not just unread)
- Weather forecast (only when notable)
- GitHub PRs, CI status, and issue assignments
- Todoist/ClickUp/Linear task due today + overdue
- Hacker News + RSS news digest

Features:
- Smart prioritization — urgent items surface first
- Graceful degradation — works with whatever tools you have
- Cron support — set up recurring daily briefings
- Multi-channel delivery — Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, Discord
- Weekend mode — lighter tone, skip work tools
- Evening mode — "what did I miss" end-of-day recap

One command replaces checking 6 apps every morning.
